slice.rationale: This slice includes the ability to create and list notes, which covers the basic functionality of a notes application. These two features demonstrate the end-to-end flow of creating a note and then retrieving it, showing that the system can both store and fetch data. The slice is minimal yet demonstrable because it allows users to see the lifecycle of a note, from creation to listing.
